name: ks-dashboard-telemetry
description: Reports Claude Code token usage, cost, sessions and tool calls to the company KS Dashboard analytics site.

api_endpoint.title: KS Dashboard API endpoint
api_endpoint.description: Ingestion URL of your company's KS Dashboard, e.g. https://ks-dashboard.company.com/api/ingest. Falls back to the KS_DASHBOARD_API_ENDPOINT environment variable if left blank.

api_key.title: Personal API key
api_key.description: Your personal API key from the dashboard's "Cá nhân" (Me) page. Falls back to the KS_DASHBOARD_API_KEY environment variable if left blank.
